name: Return to Jahan
summary: Return to Jahan marks the concluding leg of an introduction to the Horde's wind rider flight network between Mulgore and the Barrens. After visiting Thunder Bluff to deliver hides to the skinner Ahanu, travelers take a wyvern back to the Crossroads carrying finished leather wares for the merchant Jahan Hawkwing.

sections.title: Wings Over Kalimdor
sections.body: For many travelers, this errand is their first experience soaring aboard a trained wind rider. Tal, the wind rider master perched high atop Thunder Bluff's central mesa, arranges flights across the plains of central Kalimdor. As long as a traveler has already established contact with the roost at another settlement—such as Devrak's outpost at the Crossroads—these winged beasts can effortlessly cover leagues that would otherwise demand a perilous overland trek through the Red Rocks and northern Barrens.

sections.title: Commerce of the Crossroads
sections.body: The courier run serves an economic purpose alongside flight training. Jahan Hawkwing operates out of the bustling settlement of the Crossroads, where hunters, scouts, and mercenaries gather daily. Raw hides sent to Ahanu on the high rises of Thunder Bluff are refined into durable armor and equipment, then flown back to the dusty intersection of the Barrens to supply the Horde's expanding frontier efforts.

faq.answer: Jahan Hawkwing is a tauren merchant stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens. He buys and sells leather goods, relying on artisans in Thunder Bluff to turn raw beast hides into valuable gear for traveling adventurers.

faq.q: Why do I need to take a wind rider back to the Crossroads?
faq.answer: The journey demonstrates how the flight network operates. Wind rider masters like Tal in Thunder Bluff can only dispatch couriers and passengers to settlements they have personally scouted or connected with, such as Devrak's roost at the Crossroads.

Ahanu is a skilled leatherworker and skinner located on the high bluffs of Thunder Bluff. He takes raw skins shipped from hunters in the Barrens and crafts them into finished goods before returning them for sale.
Devrak is the orcish wind rider master stationed at the Crossroads. He manages the flight roost that connects the Barrens to major Horde bastions like Orgrimmar and Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Can you use a wind rider without speaking to the destination master first?
faq.answer: No. Wind riders can only be dispatched to outposts where a traveler has already met and registered with the local wind rider master, establishing the connection between roosts.

faq.q: What happens after returning the leather goods to Jahan?
faq.answer: Delivering the finished goods concludes the courier chain between Mulgore and the Barrens, leaving travelers familiar with air transit and free to continue assisting the garrison and merchants of the Crossroads.

angles.text: The wind rider routes between Mulgore, Durotar, and the Barrens are the vital arteries binding the Horde's central Kalimdor territories together.
Trade chains between Mulgore tanners and Barrens outposts demonstrate how the united tribes support the Horde's broader frontier expansion.
